stem.text: Which statement about phospholipids in the bilayer of a cell surface membrane is correct?

A.text: The non-polar phosphate heads face outwards and the polar fatty acid tails face inwards.

B.text: The polar phosphate heads face outwards and the non-polar fatty acid tails face inwards.

C.text: The non-polar fatty acid tails face outwards and the polar phosphate heads face inwards.

D.text: The polar fatty acid tails face outwards and the non-polar phosphate heads face inwards.
